usedFor: outline holds wiki documents, and viaSocket utilities waits after each “New Document Published” through “Pause Workflow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document Published” in outline, then “Pause Workflow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A publish starts a timed wait, so the next step runs a set number of minutes later.

watchOut: outline triggers are polling, so “New Document Published” starts the wait only after a scheduled check.
